name: Design
blurb: The design committee surveys the site, runs the structural calculations, and produces the drawings that our partner engineers sign off on.

name: Fundraising
blurb: The fundraising committee writes grants, contacts sponsors, and runs our fundraisers, which include bake sales, a cherry blossom souvenir sale for campus visitors, a spring soccer tournament, and an online crowdfunding campaign.

name: Outreach
blurb: The outreach committee runs our social media and recruits new members each quarter.

name: Logistics
blurb: The logistics committee plans the build trip, which covers travel, health and safety, the budget, and coordination with our partners abroad.
